answer: Price identity in burned compute so cloning never beats earning. Each signup demands a proof-of-work whose energy cannot be reused, each new self a juniper cut from real cost. The crowd reads clarity like a vine, seeing at a glance who paid dues versus copied a template; honest workers climb while a quill of record marks every verified round. Sybil farms drown in their own power bill, for the attack costs more than the sway it buys.
